Classify shots into court zones

Source: R/court.R
shot_zone.Rd

Five distance zones (detail = FALSE) or thirteen zones that also split by side of the floor (detail = TRUE): rim, paint, mid-range left / centre / right (short and long), corner 3 left / right, above-the-break 3 left / centre / right. Uses each league's own 3-point geometry. When value is missing, 2 vs 3 is inferred from the coordinates.

Usage

shot_zone(
  x,
  y,
  league = "NBA",
  value = NULL,
  detail = FALSE,
  rim_r = 1.75,
  short_r = 4.25
)

shot_zone_levels(detail = FALSE)

Arguments

x, y

Shot coordinates in metres (see geom_court()).

league

League rules, recycled.

value

Shot value (2 or 3), optional.

detail

Return the 13 side-split zones.

rim_r, short_r

Radii (m) of the rim area and of short mid-range.

Value

A factor.

Details

The rim radius is 1.75 m by default rather than the 1.22-1.25 m restricted area because EuroLeague operators record layups about 1.1 m from the hoop.

Examples

shot_zone(c(0, 3, 6.8, 0), c(0.5, 3, 0.5, 7.5), "NBA", detail = TRUE)
#> [1] Rim                  Short mid right      Corner 3 right      
#> [4] Above-break 3 centre
#> 12 Levels: Rim Paint Short mid left Short mid right ... Above-break 3 right
